Format all code using the linter formatter:
make build_staging
make test_staging
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsTests/YourTestClass/testMethodName
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsDataModelTests
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsServerTests
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsUtilsTests

Modules/: DataModel (GRDB persistence), Server (protobuf API), Utils, DependencyInjection. Main iOS app: podcasts/. Tests: PocketCastsTests/. Data operations use DataManager.sharedManager (Modules/DataModel/Sources/PocketCastsDataModel/Public/DataManager.swift).

Strings: add to podcasts/en.lproj/Localizable.strings; use generated L10n enum. Use snake_case keys (`feature_relevantIdentifier_description`); Always include comment describing context and placeholders. Use positional specifiers (`%1$@`, `%2$@`), never string interpolation. Handle plurals manually with separate `_singular`/`_plural` keys.

Use `naturalContentHorizontalAlignment` instead of `.left`/`.right` for RTL support
Use `.natural` text alignment instead of `.left`
Never use `LocalizedStringKey` in SwiftUI - use `NSLocalizedString` with L10n
When styling Views, use `<REDACTED_USER> private var theme: Theme` and inject `.environmentObject(Theme.sharedTheme)` where the View is used.
Use `AppTheme.color(for: .primaryText01, theme: theme)` to access themed colors

Regenerate protobuf after API changes:
brew install protobuf swift-protobuf  # One-time setup
make update_proto API_PATH=/path/to/pocketcasts-api/api/modules/protobuf/src/main/proto
